```{r}

# Distribution of Yield

  geom_histogram(
    bins = 20,
```

#Prepare the data for SVM

```{r}

set.seed(123)

# Split into training and testing sets
train_index <- createDataPartition(
  ChemicalManufacturingProcess$Yield,
  p = 0.80,
  list = FALSE
)

train_data <- ChemicalManufacturingProcess[train_index, ]
test_data <- ChemicalManufacturingProcess[-train_index, ]

# Median imputation, estimated using training data only
preprocess_model <- preProcess(
  train_data |> select(-Yield),
  method = c("medianImpute", "center", "scale")
)
preprocess_model
# Apply preprocessing
x_train <- predict(
  preprocess_model,
  train_data |> select(-Yield)
)
x_train
x_test <- predict(
  preprocess_model,
  test_data |> select(-Yield)
)
x_test
train_processed <- bind_cols(
  Yield = train_data$Yield,
  x_train
)
train_processed
test_processed <- bind_cols(
  Yield = test_data$Yield,
  x_test
)
test_processed
```

# Train linear and nonlinear svm

```{r}

# Linear Support Vector Regression
svm_linear <- svm(
  Yield ~ .,
  data = train_processed,
  kernel = "linear",
  cost = 1,
  epsilon = 0.1,
  scale = FALSE
)

# Nonlinear Support Vector Regression
svm_radial <- svm(
  Yield ~ .,
  data = train_processed,
  kernel = "radial",
  cost = 10,
  gamma = 1 / (ncol(train_processed) - 1),
  epsilon = 0.1,
  scale = FALSE
)

summary(svm_linear)
summary(svm_radial)

```

## compare the two models

```{r}

# Predictions on test data
linear_pred <- predict(
  svm_linear,
  test_processed
)

radial_pred <- predict(
  svm_radial,
  test_processed
)

# Model performance
linear_results <- postResample(
  pred = linear_pred,
  obs = test_processed$Yield
)

radial_results <- postResample(
  pred = radial_pred,
  obs = test_processed$Yield
)

# Comparison table
model_comparison <- data.frame(
  Model = c("Linear SVR", "Radial SVR"),
  RMSE = c(
    linear_results["RMSE"],
    radial_results["RMSE"]
  ),
  Rsquared = c(
    linear_results["Rsquared"],
    radial_results["Rsquared"]
  ),
  MAE = c(
    linear_results["MAE"],
    radial_results["MAE"]
  )
)

model_comparison

```

## Visualize actual vs predicted

```{r}

prediction_data <- data.frame(
  Actual = rep(test_processed$Yield, 2),
  Predicted = c(linear_pred, radial_pred),
  Model = rep(
    c("Linear SVR", "Radial SVR"),
    each = nrow(test_processed)
  )
)

ggplot(
  prediction_data,
  aes(x = Actual, y = Predicted)
) +
  geom_point(color = "steelblue", size = 2) +
  geom_abline(
    slope = 1,
    intercept = 0,
    linetype = "dashed",
    color = "red"
  ) +
  facet_wrap(~ Model) +
  labs(
    title = "Actual vs Predicted Manufacturing Yield",
    x = "Actual Yield (%)",
    y = "Predicted Yield (%)"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()

```
